SOLUTIONS

Managed IT & Business Continuity

We look after your IT infrastructure under a support contract with a defined scope, response targets, and a maintenance schedule, so problems are prevented, data is recoverable, and your team knows who to call.

SOUND FAMILIAR?

Problems we solve.

  • Problems discovered only when staff cannot work
  • Backups that have never been tested
  • No one responsible for updates and maintenance
  • IT support that depends on one person being available

WHAT WE DELIVER

Scope of work.

The exact scope, schedule, and price are confirmed in a written quotation.

Infrastructure monitoring

Servers, network devices, and internet links monitored, with alerts handled by our engineers.

Preventive maintenance

Scheduled checks of servers, network, and equipment on a monthly or quarterly plan.

Backup and recovery

Backups implemented, checked, and restore-tested on schedule, with an offsite copy.

Network health checks

Regular reviews of performance, security, and capacity, with clear recommendations.

Helpdesk and on-site support

Support for your staff by WhatsApp, email, phone, remote session, or site visit.

Monthly reporting

Incidents, maintenance completed, backup status, and recommendations in one report.

SERVICE LEVELS

Clear commitments, in writing.

Every support contract states exactly what is covered and how quickly we respond.

QUESTIONS

Common questions.

Used in: Trading & Distribution, Manufacturing, Corporate Offices

Do you provide 24/7 support?

Support hours and response targets are agreed in your contract. We only commit to coverage we can deliver.

Can we keep our own IT staff?

Yes. Many businesses keep an internal IT person and use us for engineering depth, maintenance, and backup.

How is the contract priced?

By the number of sites, users, servers, and devices, and the coverage required. We provide a written quotation after an assessment.
